# The Rust listener reland also renames the Graph empty-folder receiver

The original shared alias rename left Graph empty_folder importing and using SafeEwsSimpleOperationListener, with its bridge still constructing that name. The reland adds those receiver/associated-type/parameter and bridge-constructor changes to SafeExchangeSimpleOperationListener. The fixed accepted import, associated type, parameter and constructor agree. The exact original-to-reland delta is limited to these two files; other retained original hunks keep their original reader and time. This static reference difference is not a fresh compiler result or proof of the entire historical build-failure cause.

Scope: Shared Rust Exchange listeners and Graph empty-folder dispatch.
